description:
Since 2006 Cross The Road Electronics (CTR) has been a leading provider of embedded solutions for control systems including robotics, diver propulsion vehicles (DPVs), motor control & outdoor propulsion.
A trailblazer in solutions supporting robotics teams worldwide, CTR is set apart by its in-house design, assembly, & testing of its branded products. Their flagship product is the Talon FX Motor Controller, a brushless motor custom designed for the FIRST Robotics Competition. CTR's expansion into lawn mower propulsion systems leverages their proficiency in motor control.
CTR’s expertise lies in designing, developing & manufacturing hardware, software components & communication protocols to create unique, durable & cost-effective solutions.
